ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB$ is the diameter of circle $O$, points $C$ and $D$ are on circle $O$, $\angle D=60^\circ$, and $AB=10$. What is the length of $AC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect $BC$, as shown in the figure,\\
$\because$ $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, and $AB=10$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle ACB=90^\circ$,\\
$\because$ $\angle D=60^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle ABC=60^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle CAB=180^\circ-\angle ABC-\angle ACB=30^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ in $\triangle ABC$, we have: $BC=\frac{1}{2}AB=5$,\\
$\therefore$ $AC=\sqrt{AB^{2}-BC^{2}}=\sqrt{10^{2}-5^{2}}=\boxed{5\sqrt{3}}$
